name: v5.7.5
body:
# oh-my-claudecode v5.7.5: stricter frontmatter and config parsing, team startup fixes, merge-readiness MCP tools removed

## Highlights

- **feat(installer): add `claudeMdEnabled` opt-out for the global CLAUDE.md** (#4383)
- **fix: remove retired merge-readiness MCP tools** (#4422)
- **fix(team): align worker startup ACK and shutdown instructions** (#4404) and **stabilize cmux worker startup** (#4412)
- **Frontmatter parsing:** YAML block scalars `>-`/`|` (#4405), leading UTF-8 BOM in skill/command/rule files (#4408), CRLF in command files (#4402), quoted flow values (#4393)

## Bug Fixes

- fix(state-manager): match list and cleanup glob patterns literally (#4390)
- fix(ralph): retain feedback failures when tests log ENOENT (#4399)
- fix(session-start): bound the stabilization helper lifetime and batch the darwin identity probe (#4384)
- fix(learner): parse block-list skill metadata in CRLF files (#4392)
- fix(learner): match glob triggers literally apart from `*` (#4418)
- fix: ignore malformed `OMC_CONTEXT_GUARD_THRESHOLD` in the context guard (#4388)
- fix: ignore malformed values in the security config section (#4389)
- fix(rules-injector): support `{a,b}` brace alternation in rule globs (#4403)
- fix(rules-injector): ignore trailing YAML comments in rule frontmatter and preserve quoted hashes (#4407) — thanks @rudycelekli
- fix(rules-injector): read block lists indented level with their key (#4406)
- fix(wiki): accept a leading UTF-8 BOM in wiki page frontmatter
- fix(autoresearch): keep quotes inside an unquoted sandbox.md value (#4411)
- fix(cli): reject non-integer values for wait and session numeric options (#4409)
- fix(factory): validate `listen --port` as an integer in 0-65535 (#4420)
- fix(doctor): ignore empty `OMC_SKIP_HOOKS` entries (#4417)
- fix(factcheck): match strict project globs literally (#4416)
- test(session-end): stabilize configured process exit on CI (#4397)

## Install / Update

The npm CLI and the Claude Code marketplace/plugin are separate install tracks. Update whichever track you use; if you have both, update both.

**CLI / runtime:**

```bash
npm install -g oh-my-claude-sisyphus@5.7.5
```

**Claude Code plugin:**

```text
/plugin marketplace update omc
```

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-claudecode/compare/v5.7.4...v5.7.5
